svg.title: AREA 35
svg.desc: Send one warp runner while the party waits at the gate. Facing each pair, choose left, left, right: 1→2→3. Activate the platform switches to release the party, then use 4 to descend and regroup. Hug the left side of the narrow passage in your travel direction and run past the Foie turrets. Only one room remains after this optional healing ring; detour only if necessary. Break the rocks to expose the light switch, turn it on, then clear the final dark room.
